articles.body_for_parameter_review:
To increase market liquidity and improve your trading experience, Bybit will adjust the tick size for the following Perpetual Contracts on 
Jan 17, 2023, at 8AM UTC
. 

Contract Type
Contract Name
Before Adjustment
After Adjustment
USDT Perpetual
ETHUSDT
0.05
0.01

USDC Perpetual


ETH-PERP


0.05


0.01


Note:
No trading functions for Perpetual Contracts were affected during the adjustment process.
API users can obtain prices with the updated tick size via GET /derivatives/v3/public/instruments-info after the aforementioned timestamp. For more information, please refer to our 
API documentation
.
Orders placed before the aforementioned timestamp will remain in the order book with the original tick size.

If necessary, please adjust your trading strategy in accordance with the new tick size. We seek your understanding for any inconvenience caused.

Thank you for your continued support!

The Bybit Team
